prompt: Why does the tray need to go to the next bench with the letters still in order?
promptZh: 為什麼交接時托盤要連同順序未變的字一起交到下一個工作台？

options.text: So the next person can fit a different sign on the same tray.
options.zh: 讓接手的人能把另一塊招牌放進同一托盤。
options.whyZh: 托盤給鬆脫的字，不是放另一塊招牌。

options.text: So the next person can trace similar-looking letters to their original slots.
options.zh: 讓接手的人能追溯外觀相近的字各來自哪個槽位。
options.whyZh: 托盤順序保留各字對應的槽位，這是照片看不出的細節。

options.text: So the new bench can skip taking pictures of other signs.
options.zh: 讓新工作台不用再替其他招牌拍照。
options.whyZh: 其他招牌仍要先保留原有位置痕跡；此托盤只關乎這一塊。

options.text: So the letters can be sorted again by appearance.
options.zh: 讓接手的人能依外觀重排這些字。
options.whyZh: 順序應保留，不能為了按外觀分類而改動。

explanationZh: 托盤順序保留各字對應的槽位，這是照片看不出的細節。
evidence: Lay its loose letters on a tray in the order they came off. / A photograph shows the positions on the sign, but it won’t tell us which of two almost identical letters came from a particular slot. / with the letters still in order.
